metas.name: Sintel
metas.description: A lone young woman crosses a frozen world to find the baby dragon she once rescued and raised, and learns too late what the search has cost her.

metas.name: Big Buck Bunny
metas.description: A gentle giant of a rabbit has his quiet morning in the meadow ruined by three small bullies, and plans a very elaborate revenge.

metas.name: Tears of Steel
metas.description: In a future Amsterdam overrun by robots, a group of scientists stage a last attempt to save the world by replaying a breakup that went wrong.

metas.name: Cosmos Laundromat
metas.description: A suicidal sheep on a desolate island meets a salesman who offers him a sweater that can take him to any life he wants.

metas.name: Spring
metas.description: A shepherd girl and her dog face the ancient spirits of the mountain to bring the cycle of life back to their valley.

metas.name: Elephants Dream
metas.description: Two men explore a vast and shifting machine. The older one guides, the younger one starts to doubt that the machine is what he was told.

metas.name: Caminandes: Llama Drama
metas.description: Koro the llama wants the grass on the other side of the road. The road, and a fence, have other ideas.
